observations: Photo 0 shows what appears to be 2-3 solar panels leaning together against an outdoor wall, standing on tiled/paved ground.
Panels have aluminum frames, blue-black cells arranged in a grid, with a visible split/half-cut cell pattern typical of higher-wattage monocrystalline panels.
A junction box with cables is visible on the back of the front panel.
No manufacturer label, model sticker, or wattage rating is legible anywhere in the photo.
Frames show no obvious dents; glass surface shows reflections but no visible cracks in this resolution.
Background is an outdoor compound wall, not a shop or warehouse setting.

claims.evidence: No wattage/spec sticker or brand label is visible or legible in photo 0; cell pattern is consistent with mono half-cut cells but wattage cannot be confirmed from this image.
Cell color and diamond-cut corners in photo 0 are visually consistent with monocrystalline cells, but this is not conclusive proof.

risks.risk: Actual rated wattage may be lower than claimed 550w
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the rating label/sticker on the back of the panel showing Wp, Voc, Isc
risks.if_unproven: priced as lowest plausible wattage for this panel size/appearance, not as 550w

risks.risk: Panel output/performance could be degraded or non-functional (hidden cell cracks, delamination, broken bypass diodes)
risks.proof: Video of a multimeter or clamp meter reading voltage/current while panel is in direct sunlight
risks.if_unproven: priced as not verified working, i.e. at salvage/non-working risk discount

risks.risk: Physical condition of frame, back sheet, and junction box could hide cracks or water damage not visible in this single front-angle photo
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four corners, the back sheet, and the junction box/cables

risks.risk: Unclear how many panels are actually included in the sale (2 or 3 appear stacked)
risks.proof: A photo with panels separated and counted, plus a written count in the listing
risks.if_unproven: priced per single panel only, as quantity is unconfirmed

risks.risk: 'Original' / unused claim cannot be confirmed; panel could be used, pulled from a prior installation
risks.proof: Photo of original packaging, invoice, or retailer tag
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/second-hand condition regardless of claim

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating label on the back of the panel showing brand, model, and Wp rating
Video of a multimeter test under sunlight showing voltage and current output
Photos of all four corners and the back sheet for frame/cell damage
A photo showing the exact number of panels being sold, laid out separately
response.reason: The wattage claim that primarily sets the price cannot be read from any label in the photo, and cell/frame condition plus panel count are also unconfirmed, so no reliable worst-case price can be set without the rating label and a basic output test.
